weaveo.name: weaveo
weaveo.description: weaveo compares weather forecasts for your days off. See your holidays, possible destinations, forecasts from multiple sources and travel times on one planning board.
features: Plan around weekends, public holidays, alternating weekends or shift work
Compare forecasts, rainfall consensus and precipitation by time of day
Compare destinations with driving, train and flight times

benchgauge.name: AI BenchGauge
benchgauge.taglineLast: Track your quota. Know what remains.
benchgauge.description: See task-based benchmarks alongside blind user evaluations. Compare overall, coding, image and video rankings, while the desktop app tracks quota for supported accounts.
features: Compare leaderboards without losing their individual scoring scales
Explore performance by model or by company
Track account quota on desktop with fewer checks across services
